statement.note: 建表（幂等；索引三件套：认领/幂等/认领取回）

dialect.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {table} ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '主键（starsite-sequence 组件生成）', cmd_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '命令类型=执行器路由键', biz_key VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '' COMMENT '业务键(幂等/追踪)', payload TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '命令载荷 JSON', status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT 'PENDING/RUNNING/SUCCESS/DEAD', max_retry INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, retry_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_run_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '到期时间(延迟队列锚点)', last_error VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, owner VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' COMMENT '提交方服务名', claim_token VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '调度认领令牌', gmt_create DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', gmt_modified DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '修改时间', PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_status_next (status, next_run_at) COMMENT '认领查询：按状态+到期扫', KEY idx_type_biz (cmd_type, biz_key) COMMENT '幂等检查：同类型同业务键计数', KEY idx_claim_token (claim_token) COMMENT '认领取回：按令牌取本批（非唯一——一批共用令牌）' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='异步命令'

statement.note: 新建命令（id 由 sequence 组件预生成显式写入；gmt_create 取库时钟）

dialect.statement: INSERT INTO {table} (id, cmd_type, biz_key, payload, status, max_retry, retry_count, next_run_at, owner, gmt_create) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())

statement.note: 详情全量（含 payload——执行路径需要载荷）
幂等检查：同 type+key 未完成计数（idx_type_biz 前两列等值命中）

dialect.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE cmd_type = ? AND biz_key = ? AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

statement.note: 批量令牌认领第 1 步（派生表 t 绕 MySQL ERROR 1093：UPDATE 不能直接改 IN 子查询引用的同表）

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET status = 'RUNNING', claim_token = ?, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= ? AND id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?) t)

statement.note: 批量令牌认领第 2 步：按令牌取回（idx_claim_token 点查；执行路径需要载荷故全列）

dialect.statement: SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE claim_token = ? ORDER BY id

statement.note: 按 id 原子认领（IMMEDIATE 模式；到期判定用库时钟——提交线程与库视图一致）

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET status = 'RUNNING', claim_token = ?, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = ? AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= NOW()

statement.note: 崩溃回收（旧形态，保留兼容）：悬挂 RUNNING 回 PENDING。 注意：UPDATE...LIMIT 不被分片中间件支持（ShardingSphere ERROR 20046——全局 LIMIT 语义 在多分片路由下不成立），分片形态（proxy/嵌入式）须用 selectStaleIds+reclaimByIds 两步法

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET status = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND gmt_modified < ? LIMIT ?

statement.note: 崩溃回收两步法·第 1 步：选出悬挂 RUNNING 的 id（分片友好： SELECT..LIMIT 广播后按片归并，每片各取 limit 条——分片形态下批量上限=limit×分片数，语义无害）

dialect.statement: SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND gmt_modified < ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?

statement.note: 崩溃回收两步法·第 2 步：按显式 id 集回收（IN 列表全参数绑定， 占位符数量由存储层按选中条数生成——不拼接任何值；分片下按 id 等值命中各自分片）

dialect.statement: UPDATE {table} SET status = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id IN ({idPlaceholders})
UPDATE {table} SET status = ?, claim_token = ?, retry_count = ?, next_run_at = ?, last_error = ?, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = ?

statement.note: 到期积压计数（idx_status_next 完整命中）

dialect.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table} WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= ?

statement.note: 近 N 条（列表路径显式列清单：不含 payload 大列，详情走 findById）

dialect.statement: SELECT id, cmd_type, biz_key, status, max_retry, retry_count, next_run_at, last_error, owner, claim_token, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM {table} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?

statement.note: 分页计数基句（可选过滤片段见 filter.*）
分页查询基句（与 selectRecent 同口径：不拉 payload 大列）

dialect.statement: SELECT id, cmd_type, biz_key, status, max_retry, retry_count, next_run_at, last_error, owner, claim_token, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM {table} WHERE 1 = 1

statement.note: 可选过滤片段（JdbcAsyncCommandStore 用；列名白名单映射，值一律 ? 绑定）
分页排序片段（值参数绑定）

dialect.statement: ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
